subject: Consistently use static_assert across code (#2538)
reason: The change only alters how the static_assert fallback macro is defined (removing duplicate per-file fallbacks and switching the header fallback from the extern-negative-array trick to C11 _Static_assert). static_assert is a compile-time construct that generates no runtime code: a passing assertion is invisible in the binary and a failing one breaks the build, not the server. There is no runtime behaviour, reply, data format, replication, or persistence path to exercise, so no fuzzer scenario can reach the change; successful compilation of the head commit is the complete test.
